source: Change Labs (nativestartup.org) — Navajo & Hopi entrepreneur incubator cohorts
publisher: Change Labs (Native-led nonprofit, Tuba City AZ; incubator/business hub on the Navajo & Hopi Nations)
native_identifiability: Native-led incubator: cohorts of Navajo/Hopi entrepreneurs are named in press and cohort announcements (e.g. '13 Native Businesses Selected'); 76 businesses funded, $441,444 in loans. Individual Native businesses enumerable from cohort posts, not a directory page
identity_semantics: DISCOVERY ONLY: incubator participation is opt-in and program-defined, not an ownership/citizenship certification; these are person/business records (person boundary, not ingestible pre-FIELD_CLASSIFICATION). Enumerates named cohort businesses via announcements, never a roster
export: web + press (nativestartup.org/news cohort posts; Grand Canyon Trust / Tribal Business News coverage) — narrative, no list export
notes: NEW FRAME: Native entrepreneur-support orgs (incubators/TA providers) -- distinct from chambers (advocacy) and CDFIs (finance). Same discovery pattern as the CDFI borrower showcases: cohort announcements name individual Navajo/Hopi businesses that are otherwise very hard to find. Discovery grade. nation_ids: bia: Navajo Nation; Hopi Tribe of Arizona.

source: ONABEN — A Native American Business & Entrepreneurial Network
publisher: ONABEN (national 501(c)(3), founded 1991 by four Oregon tribes)
native_identifiability: National Native entrepreneur training/TA network (business service centers on/near reservations in OR and WA); promotes tribal-citizen-owned small businesses. Founded by Grand Ronde, Warm Springs, Siletz, Umatilla
identity_semantics: COVERAGE FRAME / partnership lead: a training and TA provider, not a certifier or roster. Participation is regardless of tribal affiliation, so it asserts nothing about ownership or citizenship
export: HONEST NEGATIVE: no public member directory surfaced this pass (its region's public directory is the Northwest Native Chamber, already in the registry at TBD-151). Org documented; roster not public
notes: Recorded as the TA-network peer to Change Labs; no enumerable list, so partnership-lead only. Explicitly bounded against NW Native Chamber (TBD-151) to avoid re-proposing. nation_ids: [] (multi-nation network).
